text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh? Flash, you look low-key exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I am, a bit. I had a lot of work come up

unexpectedly today.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's rough. So you gonna skip training
today?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, I will go ahead with it as planned. If
I reduce
my practice, I will only suffer
for it later trying to
rearrange my plans.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But, like, there's no point trying to
overwork
yourself now. You should just
relax and do
something fun!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, we can go out right now! I'm a
genius!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the offer, but I am not one
to
implement dubious theories so
hastily...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, just give it a try. Who knows,
maybe
you'll grow stronger if you break
out of that mold
of yours.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that got you interested, huh? Then
how
about a full glam glow-up while
we're at it? My
makeup skills are next
level!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'm afraid I'll have to pass after all...
